title: The architect session becomes the interface agent seat with its context intact: seat.sh adopts a running session as a seat, the role schema is roles/interface-agent.json, the model is Fable first (Opus or Sonnet allowed), never Sonnet by default
text: Owner, 2026-10-11 18:42Z: 'Hurry up and turn yourself into that interface agent, you transfer the seat to it, keep all context, I don't want sonnet right off the bat. It can be fable, opus or sonnet. I want it with you and all the same context we have here, but I want your schema to be it when this loop is ready.' Binding: seat.sh gains an adopt path (a seat comes up from an existing claude session id, keeping its transcript, under the role's settings and label); roles/interface-agent.json model order is fable, opus, sonnet; the switch happens when WO-20261011-e618 lands, with the architect's session id.
